m: Kofta: mix the lamb with finely grated onion, garlic, cumin, cinnamon, half the chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt. Shape into small sausages, about 3 per serve.
Chill 15 minutes so they hold together.
Salad: finely diced cucumber, tomato and red onion with the rest of the parsley, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Cook the kofta on a hot grill pan or BBQ, 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Spread hummus on each plate, add the kofta, salad, a spoon of yoghurt and flatbread on the side.
l: Kofta, salad and hummus in one container, bread on the side.
g: GF wraps instead of flatbread. Check the hummus label.
